summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ReadContext classes, a _make_read_progress helper, module-level open and wrap_file with overloads, and Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file); tests/test_progress.py (19 new tests before the script-entry block); docs/source/progress.rst (two new subsections under Advanced usage); CHANGELOG.md (one Added bullet linking PR 1759). Nothing was run: tests, mypy, and the Python 3.6 import check are unverified, and the type-ignore categories may not match what mypy reports under the repo's strict config. Nothing was committed. Extra choices beyond the spec: the reader defines name and mode properties that delegate to the handle (needed so typing.IO's abstract properties don't block instantiation on 3.6), and write raises io.UnsupportedOperation("write"). An explicit total with a missing path creates the task before the open fails, following the spec's step order.
